name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 32 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 32 hours starting 2025-10-30, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
